profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer, Builder, Tinkerer | Ex Galaxy, Fifty-five, Warner Music
profile.summary:
Senior engineering leader with 8+ years building data platforms, full-stack apps, and AI infrastructure—owning technical strategy, architecture, and the teams behind them.



AWS Cloud Architect | GCP Data Engineer



Python · SQL · AI-native development · Java · Spark · Kafka · Claude Code · Airflow · dbt · Snowflake · Databricks · React · FastAPI · Node · AWS · GCP · Azure · Kubernetes · Docker · Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed a consent-driven permission model with granular, tiered data visibility, balancing transparency with privacy across multi-user household relationships

- Built a serverless event-driven backend on AWS (FastAPI on ECS Fargate, Lambda workers, DynamoDB single-table design, Cognito, EventBridge) with KMS envelope encryption, JWT auth, role-based access control, comprehensive audit logging, and full Terraform-managed infrastructure

- Architected an AI gateway as the single policy choke point for every Bedrock call (Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5): tier-based action authorization, per-user rate limiting, NFKC-normalized input sanitization with prompt-injection blocking, and exactly-once audit per interaction

- Built an in-house observability dashboard backed by pre-aggregated DynamoDB rollups, with a live activity feed and rule-based alerts that deep-link into filtered investigation views for security incident response

- Engineered a multi-signal threat detection pipeline for inbound email, integrating third-party security APIs, protocol verification, and pattern analysis
